how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-feralas-02.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:3124:obj:0: Kill 10 Frayfeather Hippogryphs of any type, then use the Muisek Vessel to shrink and capture them.
rows.quest:3124:details:0: Since you have proven that you are both trustworthy and gifted with the ability to use the muisek vessel, I now wish you to capture another creature.
rows.quest:3124:details:1: BHippogryphs have been loyal companions to the night elves for many years; their spirits are loyal and steadfast.
rows.quest:3124:details:2: BYour task is to kill 10 frayfeather hippogryphs, and quickly, shrink and capture them with the vessel, so that their muisek may be preserved. You will find the hippogryphs in the High Wilderness, to the south of here.
rows.quest:3124:completion:0: After killing an animal, if we allowed the muisek to escape, it may take the form of an even greater creature. We would never be safe from its vengeance.
rows.quest:3124:completion:1: BThis is a dangerous job I have given you, ⟦1⟧. Again, you have completed it well.
rows.quest:3125:obj:0: Kill 8 Sprite Darters or Sprite Dragons. Use the Muisek Vessel to shrink and capture the fallen Faerie Dragons.
rows.quest:3125:details:0: ⟦2⟧, next I must have you capture a creature that in appearance, may look quite fragile, yet its powerful spirit is what we are truly after. The faerie dragons that I speak of have served the night elves as their allies. We must capture one so that the horde may benefit from this strength of spirit as well.
rows.quest:3125:details:1: BHere is the muisek, ⟦3⟧. Kill 8 sprite darters or sprite dragons, and capture their muisek. They may be found to the west of here.
rows.quest:3125:completion:0: Thank you, ⟦4⟧. Now the spiritual powers of the faerie dragon will be available to us.
rows.quest:3125:completion:1: BI hope you willing to perform another task for me.
rows.quest:3126:obj:0: Kill 3 Wandering Forest Walkers. Use the Muisek Vessel to shrink and capture the fallen Treants.
rows.quest:3126:details:0: The wandering forest walkers that can be found meandering through the forest are our next target, ⟦5⟧. Night elves have enlisted treants as allies to fight against the horde. Their movement may be slow, but their role as protectors is undeniable.
rows.quest:3126:details:1: BSoon we will be able to use this power for our own benefit.
rows.quest:3126:details:2: BFind 3 wandering forest walkers; kill them, and use the muisek vessel to shrink and capture them.
rows.quest:3126:completion:0: Thank you, ⟦6⟧. Our muisek collection is almost complete.
rows.quest:3127:obj:0: Kill 7 Land Walkers or Cliff Giants. Use the Muisek Vessel to shrink and capture the fallen Mountain Giants.
rows.quest:3127:details:0: The last task I will require of you is to travel to the northwest and find the final enemy.
rows.quest:3127:details:1: BThe mountain giants left the mountains to aid the night elves when the burning legion appeared in the world. You will know them by their massive size and the way the ground begins to shake as you travel along their rocky terrain.
rows.quest:3127:details:2: BI am eager to harness power of that size. Kill 7 mountain giants, then use the muisek vessel to capture their powerful muisek.
rows.quest:3127:completion:0: Just imagine the possibilities of what we now possess, ⟦7⟧. Along with the materials that you have collected, I will be able to forever trap the muisek of these creatures into whatever I wish.
rows.quest:3128:obj:0: Bring 2 Splintered Logs, 6 Encrusted Minerals, 20 pieces of Resilient Sinew, and 40 Metallic Fragments to Witch Doctor Uzer'i in Camp Mojache.
rows.quest:3128:details:0: I will need certain materials to complete my endeavor... You may do this alongside the other tasks I will give you.
rows.quest:3128:details:1: BI'll need a splintered log from a ⟦E1⟧ of ⟦E2⟧. Encrusted minerals, these can be found on the mountain giants and faerie dragons to the west. Also, find me some resilient sinew from the owlbeasts of the Hinterlands or hippogryphs of ⟦E2⟧. Finally, I'll need a large amount of metallic fragments from any of these creatures I mentioned.
rows.quest:3128:completion:0: Excellent! These materials, combined with the muisek, should yield just the results we've been wanting.
rows.quest:3129:obj:0: Witch Doctor Uzer'i wants you to wait for a moment while he prepares the weapons.
rows.quest:3129:details:0: Imbuing the muisek into the weapons is a difficult process. Now that I have all of the required materials and the muisek of the creatures that you captured, I may begin. Please wait; I will return in a moment.
rows.quest:3129:completion:0: As promised, you have your choice, ⟦8⟧. The muisek of the creatures has been forever sealed into the power of these weapons.
rows.quest:3129:completion:1: BYou may now wield their energy as your own. Use it well.
rows.quest:3130:obj:0: Report to Latronicus Moonspear in Feathermoon Stronghold.
rows.quest:3130:details:0: At this point, I am going to direct you to my second, Latronicus. He's been keeping a close eye on the naga forces to date. I'll assess the general situation here in regards to the naga; as much as I want to commit a full force to move against them, leaving the stronghold open to direct attack from the ⟦E3⟧ - or worse - seems less than optimal.
rows.quest:3130:details:1: BAnyway, Latronicus awaits. Good work thus far, ⟦9⟧. Keep it up.
rows.quest:3130:completion:0: Excellent, ⟦10⟧ - I value a "can do" attitude in those who I work with.
rows.quest:3130:completion:1: BI've been tasked by General Feathermoon to address the naga in a direct manner. My plans are two fold: one, we will weaken their forces both in number and in command, and two, we will uncover what they are up to in the ruins. With your help, we'll counter the naga presence without sacrificing the general security of the stronghold.
rows.quest:3445:details:0: I have heard of a place that lies deep below the surface of the earth -- banished there by powers greater than I have ever seen.
rows.quest:3445:details:1: BIf you wish to learn more of this place; the Sunken Temple, seek out a goblin named Marvon Rivetseeker. Much like Troyas and I, he has studied many ancient areas of the world. He was last known to have left his home in Ratchet to study the troll ruins in ⟦E4⟧.
rows.quest:3445:details:2: BGood luck finding him; he hasn't been heard from in some time.
rows.quest:3445:completion:0: Yes, the Sunken Temple, I can say that I have seen it with my own eyes. Perhaps you'd like to hear more about it?
rows.quest:3445:completion:1: BYou look like the adventurous type -- I know things that may intrigue you...
rows.quest:3841:details:0: Oh, hello, ⟦11⟧. I'm so glad to see you again. How was your trip to ⟦E6⟧?
rows.quest:3841:details:1: BWell, you'll be happy to know that we've made quite a bit of progress while you've been gone. We even saved a nest full of eggs. Unfortunately, the mother died before we got to her.
rows.quest:3841:details:2: BSay, would you want one for a pet? They look to hatch soon, so they'll need a good ⟦12⟧. What do you say?
rows.quest:3841:details:3: BIf you're really interested, take one of the eggs to Quentin at the race tracks in Shimmering Flats. He'll tell you more.
rows.quest:3841:completion:0: Ah, a sprite darter egg, and one near maturation, if I'm not mistaken. Remarkable you've found one, let alone in this good a condition. They're rarely seen in ⟦E2⟧ these days. I understand there were various poachers in the area trying to capture and kill them for many reasons. Too bad really... such beautiful creatures when they reach adulthood.
rows.quest:3841:completion:1: BHow did you come across such a find?
rows.quest:3842:obj:0: Bring 2 Elixir of Fortitudes to Quentin in ⟦E5⟧.
rows.quest:3842:details:0: The Moonweavers, huh? Most intriguing. I wish the sprite darters could truly appreciate what it means to have those two look after them. They are both quite capable.
rows.quest:3842:details:1: BSo, they gave you the egg as a gift. Well, then you should be responsible for it for as long as you desire. It appears it's almost ready to hatch, but we should ensure it's healthy and no damage has been done to it.
rows.quest:3842:details:2: BI only need two elixirs of fortitude for a small spell to protect the egg. I have the rest of the components here with me.
rows.quest:3842:completion:0: Wonderful. These will do nicely. Give me a moment to mix together my components and we shall see how well this egg is going to do.
rows.quest:3843:obj:0: Take your Fragile ⟦E7⟧ Egg to the Hinterlands and speak to Agnar Beastamer, but hurry, you only have 1 hour to find him before the hatchling within the egg dies.
rows.quest:3843:details:0: A magnificent specimen, ⟦13⟧. If this creature survives gestation, then it'll be a healthy pet indeed!
rows.quest:3843:details:1: BThere is one last thing I would suggest doing if you plan on following through with this--head to Aerie Peak in the Hinterlands. Speak to a dwarf there named Agnar Beastamer, he's a master animal handler and should be able to guide you in the final steps of incubation.
rows.quest:3843:details:2: BBut hurry, ⟦14⟧, this egg is fragile and will not last long without proper care.
rows.quest:3843:completion:0: Well, well, well... I haven't seen one of these in a dragon's age. Faerie dragon, if I'm not mistaken... looks to be of the sprite darter variety. Excellent, excellent indeed.
rows.quest:3843:completion:1: BWell, if this little fella's gonna hatch and live to be strong and healthy, then we should get some food for it. Good ya got it to me in time.
rows.quest:4120:obj:0: Talo Thornhoof at Camp Mojache in ⟦E2⟧ wants you to kill 12 Angerclaw Grizzlies and 12 Felpaw Ravagers in ⟦E8⟧.
rows.quest:4120:details:0: Being a hunter, I strive to emulate the strengths I see in my opponents. It is possible to turn the battle in your favor by simply knowing your enemy well, ⟦15⟧.
rows.quest:4120:details:1: BIn a place called ⟦E8⟧, north of ⟦E9⟧, the creatures have been tainted by a substance called fel. The bears and wolves have been driven mad by it, but I believe that they have also grown even stronger as well.
rows.quest:4120:details:2: BGo, ⟦16⟧. ⟦E10⟧ to ⟦E8⟧ and face these beasts. Learn for yourself if they are truly as strong as I believe.
rows.quest:4120:completion:0: It sounds from your descriptions as if the creatures show a mindless ferocity...
rows.quest:4120:completion:1: BStay alert, ⟦17⟧. It would be in your best interest to learn more of the corruption. Always know your enemy.
rows.quest:4124:obj:0: Speak with Ginro Hearthkindle in Feathermoon Stronghold.
rows.quest:4124:details:0: An associate of mine, Ginro Hearthkindle, is looking for assistance concerning the location of a courier and the parcels he was carrying. It has been a week or so since the courier went missing; our own searches have proved fruitless, and we're at an impasse. Unfortunately, I have had to declare the courier as missing in action.
rows.quest:4124:details:1: BIf you have the time and resources to spare, please speak with Ginro. He should be here in the Stronghold - perhaps in his quarters.
rows.quest:4124:completion:0: Latro sent you to me, I presume. While I think it is a lost cause at this point, I'll take whatever assistance you can offer. I must admit... I'll be glad once I can put my mind to rest on this matter. Every day I set out into the wilds of ⟦E2⟧ looking for signs of Raschal, and every night I have come back with nothing to show for my work save gnoll teeth and disappointment.
rows.quest:4125:obj:0: Locate the courier's boat somewhere along the coast of ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:4125:details:0: It's been about a week since Raschal, the courier, set out for Thalanaar. He knows ⟦E2⟧ well; he's been with us since General Feathermoon led the expeditionary forces here. I know his plan was to take a row boat down the coast and try and traverse across southern ⟦E2⟧ to avoid the ⟦E3⟧ camp.
rows.quest:4125:details:1: BI couldn't find his boat, but maybe you can. Maybe it is hidden, or maybe it was sunk. Regardless, it might hold a clue as to where he is. If you uncover something, please let me know.
rows.quest:4125:completion:0: You have found what appears to be a wrecked row boat. Through the slightly muddy water you see gaping holes riddling the port side; the boat is nearly shredded down to its simple wooden frame. Whatever broke this boat most likely tried to snap it in two. A small crest of the Feathermoon Stronghold is painted on the starboard side.
rows.quest:4125:completion:1: BIn the mud at the base of the boat, a glint of something metallic catches your eye...
rows.quest:4127:obj:0: Return to Feathermoon Stronghold and show Ginro Hearthkindle the Discarded Knife you have found.
rows.quest:4127:details:0: Running your hand along the mud, your fingers graze the handle of a knife. It looks well cared for, and it might be safe to assume that whoever was on the boat might have lost it. Perhaps the large chunk of the missing boat might have something to do with the loss.
rows.quest:4127:details:1: BYou grab the knife, remembering that Ginro Hearthkindle in the Feathermoon Stronghold instructed you to return to him with any found clues. You get the feeling, however, that you are not quite alone in the water...
rows.quest:4127:completion:0: Interesting... I believe that this is Raschal's knife. You say you found it at the bottom of the water, along with his boat? Well, just the knife's discovery might not be enough to connect this to Raschal's disappearance; we do, however, have an unconventional option available to us to try and learn more.
rows.quest:4127:completion:1: BHave you ever heard of psychometry?
rows.quest:4129:obj:0: Take the Discarded Knife to Quintis Jonespyre in Feathermoon Stronghold.
rows.quest:4129:details:0: The Stronghold's resident druid, Quintis Jonespyre, has some... unusual skills. One of them involves psychometry - the ability to reveal an item's history by touch. Don't ask me how he does it; I chalk it up to magic I do not and choose not to understand. I do know, however, two things: one, I've seen it work and two, the bum owes me.
rows.quest:4129:details:1: BTake the knife up to Quint in his little tree-house here, and tell him for me that his ⟦E11⟧ Hold 'Em debt will be paid if he works his mojo on that knife.
rows.quest:4129:completion:1: BWhile psychometry isn't an exact art by any stretch of the imagination, I've used it in times past to give insight into situations that others have chalked up to lost causes. I think using it on the knife you've uncovered will give us a glimpse into what happened to Raschal.
rows.quest:4129:completion:2: BIt will only take a moment to do, but it isn't what I'd call a caster-friendly task. Bear with me on this.
rows.quest:4130:obj:0: Speak with Ginro Hearthkindle in Feathermoon Stronghold.
rows.quest:4130:details:0: I'm a little wobbly still, sorry. Anyway, I received some useful visions.
rows.quest:4130:details:1: BRaschal takes two large leather backpacks from his boat and goes inland; he returns to the boat, however. I see gnoll scalps... he ran into some gnolls - Woodpaw I think they're called. He's very worried - almost terrified - about something. So much so, that he is not paying attention to water elementals forming behind him. The images... stop there.
rows.quest:4130:details:2: BI need to rest, sorry ⟦19⟧. Tell Gin what I've seen. He needs to know.
rows.quest:4130:completion:0: Thanks for passing along Quint's visions to me, ⟦20⟧. I'll try to remember to be a little easier on him the next time we play cards.
rows.quest:4130:completion:1: BRaschal can hold his own in a fight, and gnolls aren't anything that would get him worried - nay, terrified. Still, maybe you and yours can act on this new information and make the breakthrough we desperately need.
rows.quest:4131:obj:0: Search the Woodpaw Gnoll camps of southern ⟦E2⟧ for evidence of the courier's belongings or the courier himself.
rows.quest:4131:details:0: Our "friends" the Woodpaw might have gotten Raschal in the end, but something tells me that's not what occurred. Still, they're the best place to start looking.
rows.quest:4131:details:1: BI wish I had clearer insight as to what to do, but all I have right now is 'Search the Woodpaw camps - go.' I do know that gnolls will keep items they scavenge and fight over them; maybe they ran across the backpacks Quint mentioned. I hadn't risked a head-on fight in past searches, but with Quint's vision on this I say rip into them.
rows.quest:4131:completion:0: Tacked up on a nearby tree are two large leather backpacks. Each bears a small insignia of the Feathermoon Stronghold on the front of the pack...
rows.quest:4135:obj:0: Now that Raschal's last known whereabouts have been discovered, continue your search for him or his remains in the Writhing Deep. According to the note, it is located to the south of the Woodpaw gnoll camps.
rows.quest:4135:details:0: Inside the backpacks are two items: the first is a parcel of goods that was bound for Thalanaar, and the second is a note hastily penned to an unknown reader.
rows.quest:4135:details:1: BThe note tells of discovering insidious bug-like creatures south of the gnoll camps in a place called the Writhing Deep. The author felt the need to investigate it personally, as though it was a serious threat to all of ⟦E2⟧. The note is signed, "Raschal of Feathermoon".
rows.quest:4135:details:2: BIt would seem that you have located where Raschal ultimately went.
rows.quest:4135:completion:0: You have discovered a large pod of an alien nature. The texture of the pod appears mucous, though hardened protrusions stick out from random parts of it. The pod itself has the height and width to easily encompass a humanoid inside of it... and from the faint humanoid shape visible through the skin of the pod, you surmise that this is what it indeed encapsulates.
rows.quest:4265:obj:0: Free Raschal from the Zukk'ash hive.
rows.quest:4265:obj:1: BReturn to Ginro Hearthkindle in Feathermoon Stronghold and let him know that Raschal is alive and well.
rows.quest:4265:details:0: The pod splits opens some when you touch it, revealing a night elven male who is surprisingly still alive. He seems to be in good health, though deeply stunned. As you help him down from the pod, he stirs to life.
rows.quest:4265:details:1: B"Thank ⟦E12⟧ - you've saved me, friend! I... I'm Raschal, and I awoke paralyzed inside this pod after these bugs overwhelmed me. Were you sent by the Stronghold?"
rows.quest:4265:details:2: BIt would seem that you've found the missing courier!
rows.quest:4265:completion:0: Welcome home, ⟦21⟧. Raschal checked in just a little while ago and told me what happened.
rows.quest:4265:completion:1: BI... no, the entire Stronghold can't even begin to thank you for your great deed; Raschal would have been dead without your timely aid, and your assistance came to us without even so much as the whisper of a mercenary's fee. You bear the mark of a true hero. Know that you will always have a friend in Ginro Hearthkindle.
rows.quest:4266:obj:0: Speak with Shandris Feathermoon in Feathermoon Stronghold.
rows.quest:4266:details:0: ⟦22⟧, General Shandris Feathermoon would like to speak with you personally. No doubt she wants to thank you for your service to the Stronghold, but I do know that she also wants to talk to you about the insect creatures that you and Raschal faced in southern ⟦E2⟧. The reports of those Zukk'ash insects are... frightening, to say the least.
rows.quest:4266:details:1: BGeneral Feathermoon is waiting for you in the main compound.
rows.quest:4266:completion:0: ⟦23⟧, I give you my warmest thanks for the aid you've given us. Your bravery in the face of overwhelming odds has warranted a reward worth a thousand times greater. Nevertheless, I hope you accept this on behalf of the entire Stronghold.
rows.quest:4266:completion:1: BNow, if I may... I'd like to ask for your aid one more time. In light of the discovery of the Zukk'ash hive here in ⟦E2⟧, I think you're the best choice for this mission.
rows.quest:4267:obj:0: Bring Raschal's Report to Gracina Spiritmight in ⟦E6⟧.
rows.quest:4267:details:0: I am entrusting you with a copy of the report Raschal made on the infestation of southeastern ⟦E2⟧. While the main report is being filed in ⟦E6⟧, I want you to give this copy to an associate of the Protectorate. Her name is Gracina Spiritmight; she is a priestess who dwells in the Temple of the Moon in ⟦E6⟧. She has broad knowledge on these kinds of creatures, and her receiving this report would benefit us all.
rows.quest:4267:details:1: BYou're dismissed - good luck, ⟦24⟧; may ⟦E12⟧ watch over us all.
rows.quest:4267:completion:0: We night elves know of the terror outlined in this report. Shandris was wise to send this, and you, to me.
rows.quest:4267:completion:1: BThese creatures will consume ⟦E2⟧ rapidly; they are nothing short of one of the greatest menaces we all will ever face. The insects you and the courier encountered are known as the silithid. They are mere tools of one of the greatest threats that both the ⟦E3⟧ and ⟦E13⟧ will ever face.
rows.quest:4267:completion:2: BI pray we will have the resolve to defeat them before they destroy us.
rows.quest:4281:obj:0: Bring the Undelivered Parcel to Falfindel Waywarder in Thalanaar.
rows.quest:4281:details:0: This parcel of goods you found in the Woodpaw gnoll camps was supposed to be delivered to the small way-station of Thalanaar in southeastern ⟦E2⟧. Regardless of the missing courier's fate, the task of delivering the parcel remains unfinished.
rows.quest:4281:details:1: BExamining the parcel in detail reveals a hand written name of "Falfindel Waywarder" on the outside of the packaging. Perhaps this is the parcel's ultimate recipient.
rows.quest:4281:completion:0: ⟦E12⟧ be praised, the delivery from Feathermoon Stronghold has finally arrived!
rows.quest:4281:completion:1: BYour presence here indicates to me that perhaps some ill fate may have befallen Raschal, our usual courier. I hope that everything works out. I know that recently, the Woodpaw have become highly agitated from some source to their south. Maybe he fell to the wilds there; I would be careful, friend.
rows.quest:4281:completion:2: BRegardless, thank you again. Here is payment for this parcel's delivery.
rows.quest:4297:obj:0: Bring 5 Silvermane Stalker Flanks to Agnar Beastamer in Hinterlands.
rows.quest:4297:details:0: Sprite darters are omnivores--that means they eat both meat and vegetation. If your egg here's gonna hatch, we best be prepared. Some good eats for these little guys are flanks of meat, raw and juicy, believe it or not. I was never able to find out why, but it has somethin' to do with ⟦E12⟧'s plan for the elves... maybe they were to be protectors or somethin', I don't know.
rows.quest:4297:details:1: BI'll take care of the egg for now, why don't you get me some good Silvermane stalker flanks for 'em to eat when he's hatched.
rows.quest:4297:completion:0: These'll do nicely, and if I'm not mistaken, your little egg's just about ready to hatch. How does it feel? You know, you about to be a ⟦25⟧? Haha, didn't think ya'd have to deal with such responsibility, now did ya?
rows.quest:4298:obj:0: Speak to Agnar Beastamer in the Hinterlands.
rows.quest:4298:details:0: Whoa, it was a lot more ready than I thought...
rows.quest:4298:completion:0: Here, take the egg... better you have it so it bonds to you and looks to you to be its ⟦26⟧.
rows.quest:7003:obj:0: Use Zorbin's Ultra-Shrinker to zap any kind of giant found in ⟦E2⟧ into a more manageable form. Bring 15 Miniaturization Residues found on the zapped versions of these giants to Zorbin Fandazzle at the docks of the Forgotten Coast, ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:7003:details:0: I'm going to have to do something about the giants if I stay out here! They're certainly not good for business, now are they?
rows.quest:7003:details:1: BI've been working on a variant of a gnomish shrinking ray, but I'm using superior GOBLIN technological advances in its construction! In an effort to avoid inconveniences for myself such as death, I'd like for you to try it out on any of the giants in ⟦E2⟧. You should find miniaturization residue on them after you shrink them - bring me back some!
rows.quest:7003:completion:0: Splendifimous! Not only am I glad to see that you've returned with the residue, but also with all your major appendages intact! That is, well, there was never any danger in using the Ultra-Shrinker, now was there!
rows.quest:7003:completion:1: BI do appreciate your effort on my behalf, ⟦28⟧. Truly, you are a friend to goblins everywhere. Accept this as a token of my appreciation!
rows.quest:7721:obj:0: Collect 10 ⟦E14⟧ Cores from the Sea Elementals and Sea Sprays along the Forgotten Coast of ⟦E2⟧, and bring them back to Zorbin Fandazzle who is near the dock there.
rows.quest:7721:details:0: If I bet against my own better judgment and stay to run an engineering shop along the Forgotten Coast, I will need to deal with these pesky elementals. Curse the powers of elementalism unchecked, I say!
rows.quest:7721:details:1: BFortunately for me, and now for you my hopeful agent provocateur, the elementals represent an ideal source of raw power for my Ultra-Shrinker refinement - give them the what-for I say! When doing this though, be sure to save me the water elemental cores!
rows.quest:7721:completion:0: Scrumdillyriffic! These cores will keep me working for some time. Add to that the benefit of there now being fewer elementals along the coast, and I might no longer cry myself to sleep at the prospect of having set up shop in perhaps the worst place imaginable!
rows.quest:7721:completion:1: BThank you, ⟦29⟧, for your efforts on my behalf. While it certainly straps me financially to do this, allow me to show you some gratitude you may understand and appreciate... loot!
rows.quest:7730:obj:0: Bring 20 Zukk'ash Carapaces to Hadoken Swiftstrider at Camp Mojache, ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:7730:details:0: From what scouting we have managed to muster, we believe that the foe south of the gnolls is an insect-like race. Frankly, it is irrelevant whether or not if they're sentient. If they are driving the gnolls to frenzy against us, then they are as big of a threat - if not more - than the gnolls.
rows.quest:7730:details:1: BDrive deep into where these Zukk'ash insects dwell; it is known as the Writhing Deep. Thin their numbers and report back to me what you find, bringing back their carapaces as evidence of your handiwork.
rows.quest:7730:completion:0: Well done, ⟦30⟧. Though the extensiveness of the Zukk'ash presence will not be thwarted with anything less than a full-scale invasion, you have bought us some time so we can devise a proper strategy.
rows.quest:7730:completion:1: BI will be sure to have these carapaces analyzed; we'll need to learn everything about them before we deal with what has unfortunately turned into a much larger issue than we had anticipated.
rows.quest:7731:obj:0: Defeat Stinglasher in the Writhing Deep, bringing its glands back to Hadoken Swiftstrider at Camp Mojache, ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:7731:details:0: In surveying the Writhing Deep, one of our scouts reported seeing a giant insect - much larger than the other insects spotted - wandering about the twisted terrain. Not only is it larger, it also seems to secrete some sort of aura that the other insects don't. We've given it a name - Stinglasher.
rows.quest:7731:details:1: BThe innards of this beast would be invaluable to study as we figure out the best way to deal with this new threat. ⟦E15⟧ out its secretion glands and bring it back to me immediately!
rows.quest:7731:completion:0: Impressive, ⟦31⟧... most impressive! If Stinglasher is indeed one of their strongest creatures, the study of the beast will prove to be quite valuable in time. It's now my charge to make sure we defend ourselves long enough to take advantage of it.
rows.quest:7731:completion:1: BPlease accept this coin bounty as a token of the entire camp's thanks, ⟦32⟧. Well done.
rows.quest:7732:obj:0: Deliver the Camp Mojache Zukk'ash Report to Zilzibin Drumlore. He resides in the Drag of ⟦E16⟧.
rows.quest:7732:details:0: You've done doubly well in addressing the threat that the Zukk'ash insects pose to Camp Mojache. The threat these things pose is far from over, and I'd like to ask you for one last task on behalf of the ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:7732:details:1: BThis is a document that details all the information we have learned about these Zukk'ash insects. I want you to deliver it to Zilzibin Drumlore in the Drag of ⟦E16⟧. He's an expert on alien creatures like these; I hope he can do something with the lore we've obtained.
rows.quest:7732:completion:0: Ah, I've been expecting this. These creatures you faced... they are an ancient threat that the ⟦E3⟧ continues to choose to ignore. Hadoken was wise to bring this - and you - to me.
rows.quest:7732:completion:1: BThe Zukk'ash are nothing more than creatures called the silithid. Some would think that they are a mindless nuisance, but let me assure you - they are a far, far worse threat than anything the ⟦E13⟧ could muster.
rows.quest:7732:completion:2: BIf you're willing and strong enough, I could use your aid in bringing this threat to light.
rows.quest:7733:obj:0: Bring 10 Rage Scar Yeti Hides to Pratt McGrubben at Feathermoon Stronghold, ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:7733:details:0: I have a lead on an even BETTER source of hides, if that's even possible to believe! In the northern parts of ⟦E2⟧ - deep within Rage Scar Hold - are another throng of yetis. They're much tougher than the ones you dealt with before, so if you're up for a bigger challenge you'd best be on your toes!
rows.quest:7733:details:1: BI would reward you handsomely for a stack of ten of their hides; bring them to me here, and we'll finish our business.
rows.quest:7733:completion:0: Excellent, excellent! These are going to work out incredibly well - I can already tell that they're going to be much harder when properly cured.
rows.quest:7733:completion:1: BThanks again for your help ⟦33⟧. Here - please take one of my latest creations.
